name: 賞与 (bonus)
authority: 健康保険法 art.3(6) and 厚生年金保険法 art.3(1)(iv): a bonus paid three times a year or less is 賞与, assessed on the standard bonus amount (健保法 art.45, 厚年法 art.24の4), not the monthly grade; wages for labour insurance; withheld by the bonus rate table (所得税法 art.186(1)(ii)). The 賞与支払届 is due within 5 days (健保則 art.27, 厚年則 art.19の5).

name: 休業手当 (shutdown allowance)
authority: 労働基準法 art.26: for a shutdown attributable to the employer, at least 60% of the average wage (art.12; entry.facts.average_daily_wage) for each day (entry.quantity days); the larger of the amount entered and that minimum is paid. It is a wage: remuneration, labour insurance wages and salary income.

name: 休業補償 待期3日間 (injury absence compensation, first 3 days)
authority: 労働基準法 art.76(1): for an occupational injury the employer pays 60% of the average wage for each day of absence; from the fourth day 労働者災害補償保険法 art.14 pays the 休業補償給付, so the employer's own liability is the first three days (entry.quantity, at most 3). Compensation is not a wage (not remuneration, not labour insurance wages) and not taxable (所得税法 art.9(1)(iii)(イ), 施行令 art.20(1)(ii)).

name: 解雇予告手当 (pay in lieu of dismissal notice)
authority: 労働基準法 art.20(1)–(2): a dismissal needs 30 days' notice or the average wage (art.12; entry.facts.average_daily_wage) for each day of notice short of 30 (entry.facts.notice_days_given); paid at the latest on the dismissal day (昭和23年3月17日 基発464号). Taxed as retirement income (所得税基本通達30-5), outside social and labour insurance.

name: 退職手当 (retirement allowance)
authority: No statute requires a retirement allowance; where the work rules provide one (労働基準法 art.89(iii)の2) it is paid as they state. Retirement income (所得税法 art.30), withheld by RETIREMENT_TAX; not remuneration for social insurance or wages for labour insurance.
